statement: Let B/S be smooth and locally of finite type, and let U /S be a smooth curve of allowed legs. Assume the split spherical disc models, proper bounds, and smooth exact-position maps described in Section 2.1. Then there are natural comparisons Hecke0 I,V (ΨF) ∼ − → ΨB×SU I Heckeη̄ I,V (F) (F ∈ Dlcc(Bη̄, E)), compatible with the entire relative Hecke system of Definition 2.1. Consequently, if F has a coherent lisse eigenvalue whose lattices satisfy Proposition 2.2 compatibly as a tensor system, ΨF has the specialized coherent eigenvalue.
